Micron’s historical June 2025 US$200B announcement is retained alongside its July 2026 increase to more than US$250B through 2035.

pins.description: Micron’s June 2025 plan combined approximately US$150 billion for memory manufacturing with US$50 billion for R&D. The historical commitment covered Idaho, New York and Virginia; a later July 2026 announcement increased planned U.S. investment above US$250 billion.

This is the June 2025 announcement; the later US$250 billion-plus total in this thread supersedes it.
